Change.description: Change in mentions against the window before, in percent. Empty when the window before had none.

Category.description: Category the provider files it under.

Before30d.description: The crowd's probability for the winner 30 days before it settled. Empty when there was no price yet.

Sentiment.description: Reading of the text: Bullish, Bearish, Neutral or Unscored.

Score.description: FinSocial's score for the ticker in this video.
FinSocial's score for the video, 0 to 10. Empty when not scored yet.

Signal.description: FinSocial's own signal for the video: VSS, SS, S, NS, N, NB, B, SB or VSB. Empty when not scored yet.

Summary.description: FinSocial's summary of the video. Empty when it has none yet.

Calls.description: What was read about each ticker the video names.
